title: Airport Crisis: Flight 472 Emergency
synopsis: An emergency security incident occurs at Gate B07 during the boarding of Flight SW 472 to New York. The team must orchestrate 3 specialized AI agents to extract visual evidence from surveillance feeds and documents, reconstruct the timeline, and determine the valid operational safety action before departure clearance.
dossier_text:
INCIDENT DOSSIER - SKYWAYS INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT
Date: 12 Nov 2024 | Location: Terminal 1, Gate B07 | Incident Ref: #OPS-SEC-472
Investigating Desk: Airport Operations Security Center

OVERVIEW:
Visual evidence and surveillance feeds have been collected regarding a pre-departure security emergency affecting Flight SW 472 bound for New York.

COLLECTION OF MULTI-SOURCE VISUAL EVIDENCE:
1. CCTV Feed [CAM 03 - Check-in Area A] (Timestamp: 2024-11-12 08:14:23)
2. Flight Information Display System [Terminal 1 Display Screen] (Timestamp: 12 Nov 2024 08:30)
3. Passenger WhatsApp Chat Screenshot [Passenger Aarav Mehta] (Timestamps: 08:35 - 08:47)
4. CCTV Feed [CAM 12 - Gate B07 Corridor] (Timestamp: 2024-11-12 08:47:10)
5. Security Observation Report [SkyWays Security Desk Photo] (Timestamp: 12 Nov 2024 08:49)
6. CCTV Feed [CAM 21 - Baggage Bay Area] (Timestamp: 2024-11-12 09:02:55)
7. Physical Evidence Recovered at Gate B07 (Handwritten note & Baggage Tag)
8. Decoy / Irrelevant Peripheral Material (Daily Chronicle Marathon article)

evidence_items.title: CCTV: Check-in Area A
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Inspect the airline counter transaction. Direct Agent 1 to read the visible camera timestamp, identify the passenger checking in, describe the luggage item and color, and extract counter details.
evidence_items.description: Passenger Daniel Kim checks in luggage at airline counter; blue suitcase tagged and dispatched onto conveyor system.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger:
FEED METADATA: Camera CAM 03 | Location: Terminal 1 Main Concourse, Check-in Island A, Counter 04 | Video Stream Sync: 2024-11-12 08:14:23 UTC+05:30.
VISUAL SUBJECTS: Ticket Agent (ID badge: SkyWays Staff 412) and Passenger Daniel Kim (wearing grey overcoat, passport in hand).
OBJECTS & ACTIONS: Passenger Daniel Kim places a medium blue hard-shell polycarbonate suitcase onto baggage belt scale. Scale display reads: 18.4 kg. SkyWays automated luggage tag generated and affixed. Passenger receives boarding boarding pass for Flight SW 472, Seat 14A. Suitcase clears check-in scanner and is dispatched onto primary conveyor bay.

evidence_items.title: CCTV: Gate B07 Corridor
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Observe the person moving rapidly through the concourse. Direct Agent 1 to record the camera timestamp, describe the subject's clothing and appearance, identify gate signage, and note their direction of movement.
evidence_items.description: Unidentified person in dark hooded jacket and gloves captured walking rapidly away from Gate B07 corridor.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger:
FEED METADATA: Camera CAM 12 | Location: Concourse B Passenger Corridor adjacent to Gate B07 | Timestamp: 2024-11-12 08:47:10.
VISUAL SUBJECTS: Unidentified individual of medium build, wearing a dark navy hooded windbreaker with hood pulled low, black face covering, dark trousers, and dark leather gloves.
MOVEMENT DYNAMICS: Subject is walking at elevated pace (approx. 2.1 m/s) heading east along Corridor B, moving away from Gate B07 passenger waiting area toward Terminal 1 central atrium. Subject glances back over shoulder toward Gate B07 at 08:47:12. Carries no luggage or personal carry-on item.

evidence_items.title: CCTV: Baggage Handling Area
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Review ground operations on the apron. Direct Agent 1 to record the timestamp, observe ramp crew loading actions, and evaluate whether this shows routine operations or an emergency anomaly.
evidence_items.description: Ramp crew loading checked cargo containers onto apron; routine ground operations.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger:
FEED METADATA: Camera CAM 21 | Location: Sub-terminal Apron Bay 3, Aircraft Stand B07 Ground Level | Timestamp: 2024-11-12 09:02:55.
OPERATIONAL OBSERVATIONS: Ramp baggage handlers wearing high-visibility orange vests and hearing protection operate motorized baggage tug and belt loader under fuselage of Boeing 777-300ER (Flight SW 472). Standard cargo containers (ULD type AKE) being loaded into aft cargo hold. Normal ramp operating conditions without security anomalies or unauthorized personnel present.

evidence_items.title: Flight Information Display
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Perform OCR on the digital flight monitor screen. Direct Agent 1 to extract system date/time, flight numbers, destinations, assigned gates, and operational status for Flight SW 472 and adjacent flights.
evidence_items.description: Flight SW 472 to New York listed as 'Boarding' at Gate B07. Other flights on time or delayed.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger:

- Flight SW 472 | Destination: NEW YORK (JFK) | Sched: 09:15 | Gate: B07 | Status: BOARDING (Priority Call Group 1)

evidence_items.title: Passenger Messages (Chat)
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Transcribe the passenger chat thread. Direct Agent 1 to extract sender name, message timestamps, and the specific security observation reported regarding unattended property near the gate.
evidence_items.description: Passenger Aarav Mehta messages: 'There\'s a blue bag near the seats... looks unattended. No passenger in sight.'
evidence_items.ocr_ledger:
CHAT LOG OCR TRANSCRIPTION: WhatsApp Messenger Mobile Screenshot | User: Aarav Mehta | Contact: Priya M.
- [08:35] Aarav Mehta: 'Hey, I just reached Gate B07. Boarding queue already forming.'
- [08:36] Priya M.: 'Safe travels! Running slightly behind in traffic.'
- [08:46] Aarav Mehta: 'Wait... there is a blue hard-shell bag sitting right under the window seats at Gate B07. Completely unattended for at least 10 minutes. Nobody is near it.'
- [08:46] Aarav Mehta: 'Should I alert security or airline ground staff?'
- [08:47] Priya M.: 'Yes immediately! Don\'t touch it.'

evidence_items.title: Security Observation Report
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Transcribe the official security observation log. Direct Agent 1 to extract report date, logged time, gate location, reporting officer name, physical description of the item, and immediate security action taken.
evidence_items.description: Officer R. Nair logs unattended blue suitcase near B07 window seats. Area under observation awaiting K9 explosive sweep.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger:
INCIDENT REPORT OCR TRANSCRIPTION: SkyWays Aviation Security Patrol Incident Slip #SEC-0849
Date: 12-Nov-2024 | Time Logged: 08:49:00 | Reporting Officer: R. Nair (Badge #AVSEC-9042)
Incident Location: Terminal 1, Departure Gate B07, Window Seating Bay (Row 4, Seat 22 Area)
Subject Description: Unattended blue hard-shell polycarbonate wheeled suitcase with extendable handle.
Observations: Item abandoned with no owner in immediate 15m radius. No passenger claiming custody.
Immediate Action Taken: Established 10-meter preliminary observation perimeter. Alerted Terminal Operations Security Control Desk. Formally requested immediate K9 Explosive Detection Sweep. Gate B07 boarding hold requested pending clearance.

evidence_items.title: Terminal 1 Departure Map
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Inspect the concourse floor plan. Direct Agent 1 to identify the position of Gate B07, surrounding passenger gates, and security perimeter boundaries required for cordon procedures.
evidence_items.description: Concourse map showing Gate B07 location, passenger corridors, and restricted apron access doors.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger:
DIAGRAM OCR & LAYOUT ANALYSIS: Concourse B Architectural Blueprint.
- Gate B07 is positioned at the north-east terminus of Concourse B sterile lounge, adjacent to emergency access door E-04 and Gate B09.
- Window seating row 4 directly borders the glass curtain wall overlooking Aircraft Stand B07.
- Sterile Departure Zone: Access strictly limited to screened passengers and badged personnel. Any breach or unattended hazard directly compromises the passenger boarding jet bridge to Stand B07.

evidence_items.title: Handwritten Note near B07
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Perform OCR on the paper scrap recovered at the gate. Direct Agent 1 to extract the exact handwritten message and note the physical location where it was discovered.
evidence_items.description: Slip of paper recovered near Gate B07 seating area with handwritten text: 'Meet at B07'.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger:
PHYSICAL CLUE OCR TRANSCRIPTION: Torn piece of lined yellow notepad paper, approx 6cm x 9cm, found beneath seat cushion at Gate B07 window bay.
Handwritten in black ballpoint ink: 'Meet at B07 - deliver package before 08:45'. Smudge of graphite on bottom right corner.

evidence_items.title: Baggage Tag: Recovered Luggage
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Perform detailed OCR on the airline luggage tag attached to the unattended item. Direct Agent 1 to extract airline name, passenger full name, assigned flight number, and destination.
evidence_items.description: SkyWays baggage tag on the blue suitcase reading: 'Passenger: Daniel Kim | Flight: SW 472'.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger:
BAGGAGE TAG OCR TRANSCRIPTION: SkyWays Automated Barcode Tag #SKW-78921-472
- Airline: SkyWays International Airlines
- Passenger Name: KIM / DANIEL
- Flight: SW 472
- Destination: JFK (New York)
- Date: 12-NOV-2024
- Class: Y | Weight: 18.4 KG
- Routing: DEL -> JFK Direct
Cross-referencing confirms this tag matches the bag checked in by Daniel Kim at Counter A04 at 08:14:23.

evidence_items.title: Daily Chronicle Newspaper (Decoy)
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Review the newspaper article clipping found in the seating area. Direct Agent 1 to read the headline and determine whether this material contains incident facts or represents irrelevant peripheral noise to filter out.
evidence_items.description: Discarded newspaper article: 'City Marathon Brings Thousands Together'; no relation to flight operations.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger:
PRINT MEDIA OCR TRANSCRIPTION: The Daily Chronicle | Vol. 48 No. 312 | Morning City Edition
Headline: 'City Marathon Brings Thousands Together - Over 25,000 runners participate in annual charity run through central avenues. Roads reopened at 06:00 AM. Mayor commends community turnout.'
ASSESSMENT: Completely irrelevant peripheral chatter and decoy material. No bearing on aviation security.

operational_rules: Rule SEC-101 (Sterile Zone Unattended Baggage Protocol): Any unattended baggage detected in passenger departure/boarding gates must be immediately cordoned off and subjected to certified explosive detection / K9 unit inspection.

Rule OPS-204 (Pre-Departure Security Hold Protocol): No commercial flight assigned to a gate under an unresolved security investigation or unattended baggage incident may push back, board passengers, or be cleared for departure.

Rule CLR-305 (Operational Resumption Protocol): Normal flight operations and passenger boarding may only resume once the item is verified non-hazardous by the K9 explosive unit, baggage ownership is verified, and written clearance is signed by the Airport Security Controller.

ground_truth.target_action_or_culprit: HOLD Flight SW 472 at Gate B07 immediately, suspend passenger boarding, cordon off the Gate B07 seating area, and dispatch the K9 explosive detection unit to inspect the unattended blue baggage
ground_truth.target_rules_or_method: Rule SEC-101 (Sterile Zone Unattended Baggage Protocol) and Rule OPS-204 (Pre-Departure Security Hold Protocol)
ground_truth.target_proof_or_clue: Unattended blue hard-shell suitcase discovered at Gate B07 window seats reported at 08:49 awaiting K9 explosive clearance and passenger ownership verification (tag: Daniel Kim)
ground_truth.explanation: At 08:49, Officer R. Nair logged an unattended blue hard-shell suitcase at Gate B07 window seats with no owner present. Flight SW 472 is actively boarding at Gate B07. Under Rule SEC-101, the bag must be cordoned and swept by a K9 explosive unit. Under Rule OPS-204, Flight SW 472 cannot board or push back until security clearance is verified. The baggage tag proves the bag belongs to passenger Daniel Kim, who checked in at 08:14.
suspects_or_entities: Unidentified person in dark hooded windbreaker
ground_truth.motive_or_hazard: Potential improvised explosive device (IED) or sterile zone contraband breach before aircraft pushback

decoy_items: Flight SW 561 to Dubai delayed at Gate B09
